concept_fidelity.interpretation: Formal-section coverage measures representation fidelity only. The augmented section adds observed singleton arcs to guarantee arc coverage; it is not itself a formal-concept-only target set.

limitations: This bounded pilot evaluates static arc LP only. It is not a hyperlink-event evaluation.
The final plan additionally requires event-first masks, target-specific hard panels, ERGM score lifts, conditional simulation, and pilot-gate review.
AUC values evaluate uncalibrated heuristic scores; log loss is reserved for calibrated probabilities such as ERGM conditional scores.
